part.text:
{
  "output_quality": {"score": 4, "reason": "A clean, competent cartoon-style race scene: horses, jockeys, grandstand, tote board, flags and sun are all recognizable, with layered shapes and shading. Nothing is blank, clipped or malformed; the flat vector style is appealing but not extraordinary."},
  "instruction_following": {"score": 5, "reason": "Single self-contained 1200x800 SVG, valid XML, no external assets or JavaScript. Includes sky/sun/clouds, turf track with rails and finish beam, grass, five distinctly coloured horses with different silks, crowd grandstand, tote board and photo-finish camera; horses translate across the track at different speeds with cycling legs, plus clouds, flags, tote board and dust animating."},
  "creativity": {"score": 4, "reason": "Conventional race-day composition enlivened by narrative details: a tote board listing countries and times, a photo-finish flash, waving flags and a packed dot-matrix crowd. Varied silks and coat colours add charm, though the layout stays within expected genre bounds."},
  "animation_fidelity": {"score": 5, "reason": "Motion genuinely works: across the three frames horses translate horizontally at different speeds toward the finish line, legs cycle through gallop poses, and clouds, flags, the tote board and dust all animate continuously rather than bobbing in place."},
  "richness_detail": {"score": 5, "reason": "Very dense scene: 25 gradients, hundreds of crowd dots, layered grandstand tiers, tote board text, sun glow, dust puffs, shaded coats and flowing manes/tails. Substantial depth and detail throughout."},
  "composition_aesthetics": {"score": 4, "reason": "Well-balanced landscape framing: grandstand anchors the left background, the track sweeps right to the finish beam, and the tote board sits in the upper right without crowding. Harmonious greens and blues with colourful silks as accents; legible and polished."},
  "summary": "A rich, fully self-contained animated horse-race SVG that meets every hard requirement with working horizontal horse motion and abundant detail."
}
